verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover self-hosted deployment on own infrastructure/servers/browsers/LLM keys, and a runtime probe confirms the OSS package installs and runs locally via CLI. Community note on AGPL3 licensing confirms it is genuinely open-source and self-hostable, though this same license is cited as an adoption blocker for some enterprises. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full self-hosted deployment (beyond CLI install) and clearer documentation of infra requirements/scaling.
